reconcile.connective: Commentators read Zion and heaven as two senses of one presence: heaven the seat of God's glory, Zion the seat of his gracious nearness.

discrepancy.connective: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists these Zion-dwelling and heaven-dwelling verses side by side as a flat, unreconciled contradiction about God's residence.

skeptic.name: Steve Wells
skeptic.work: The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "Where does God dwell?" (skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/zion.html)
skeptic.attribution: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (online; contra/zion.html)

excerpts.excerpt_text: As the special residence of his glory is in heaven, so the special residence of his grace is in his church, of which Zion was a type.
excerpts.on_tension_rationale: Directly reconciles the Zion-vs-heaven tension by distinguishing two senses of divine presence -- the 'special residence of glory' (heaven, matching Ps 123:1/Eccl 5:2) from the 'special residence of grace' (Zion/church, matching Ps 9:11, 76:2, 132:13-14, Joel 3:17,21) -- naming Zion a 'type' rather than a literal rival location.

pd_work.resource: John W. Haley, An Examination of the Alleged Discrepancies of the Bible (1874), section "Dwells in heaven. Dwells in Zion." (p. 103)
pd_work.author: John W. Haley
pd_work.note: Haley sets Psalm 123:1 ("dwellest in the heavens") directly against Psalm 9:11 and 76:2 ("dwelleth in Zion"/"his dwelling-place in Zion") under this exact heading and resolves it through the doctrine of omnipresence: "An omnipresent Being may do both -- dwell in eternity, and with men too... To a mind capable of comprehending the meaning of the term 'omnipresence' these texts are seen to be in perfect harmony," citing "Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the Lord" (Jer 23:24).

link.title: GotQuestions: If God is omnipresent, then what is special about being in the presence of God?
link.note: live apologetic treatment distinguishing God's all-pervading omnipresence from his manifest/special presence -- the same mechanism used to reconcile 'dwells in heaven' with 'dwells in Zion'
